title: EEG for children
what: A nurse puts a cap with sensors on your child's head and records brain activity. It is safe. The sensors send nothing, they only listen.
why: For seizures, fainting, strange episodes, delayed development, sleep problems, or when a neurologist orders it.
duration: usually 30 to 60 minutes; a sleep EEG takes longer; the report is usually ready in 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: What the episodes that worry you look like
Videos of the episodes on your phone, if you have them
Whether a sleep recording is needed. Ask in advance

prepare.title: Hair
prepare.text: Wash your child's hair the day before, with no oil or styling products. Undo braids.

prepare.title: Sleep
prepare.text: If a sleep recording is needed, bring your child tired, before a nap. The clinic will tell you how.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Feed your child. Hungry children are more restless.

prepare.title: Mindset
prepare.text: Tell your child: we will put on a cap like an astronaut's, and it will not hurt.

bring: Videos of episodes, if you have them
A favorite toy, a bottle, and a sheet
A towel to dry the hair afterward
steps: Your child sits on your lap or on the couch
A cap with electrodes is put on, with gel under them
Your child is asked to sit still and open and close their eyes
Older children may be asked to breathe fast or look at a flashing light
Sometimes the recording is made while your child sleeps
The cap is removed, and the gel is wiped off
feel: Your child may not like the cap. Your calm helps
after: Wash your child's hair at home
Your child can go back to a normal day
The report is usually ready in 1 to 3 days. Go over it with a neurologist
red_flags: A seizure lasting more than 5 minutes, or your child does not come round after a seizure: call emergency services

faq.a: No. The electrodes only record. They send nothing into the head.

faq.q: Why are we asked to come sleepy?
faq.a: During sleep, the EEG sometimes shows what cannot be seen while awake.

reminders.text: Your child's EEG is tomorrow. Wash the hair with no oil or styling products. Bring a toy and a towel.
